 US stocks: US market opens lower after Nvidia CEO steps down
 SECTIONS US stocks: US market opens lower after Nvidia CEO steps down Reuters Last Updated: Nov 12, 2026, 08:30:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Wall Street's main indexes opened lower on Thursday after Nvidia said CEO Jensen Huang was stepping down, leaving the AI industry without its biggest champion.
 Reuters A street sign for Wall Street is seen outside the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) in New York City. Wall Street's main indexes opened lower on Thursday after Nvidia said CEO Jensen Huang was stepping down, leaving the AI industry without its biggest champion.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 58.5 points, or 0.11%, at the open to 52,427.94. The S&P 500 fell 68.5 points, or 0.90%, at the open to 7,550.84, while the Nasdaq Composite dropped 374.1 points, or 1.47%, to 25,092.109.
